children: Export sales of U.S. corn for the week ended September 10 landed on the low side of analyst forecasts, according to data from the Department of Agriculture.

In its weekly export sales report published Thursday, the USDA said that export sales of corn totaled 1.03 million metric tons for the 2026/27 marketing year. That's on the low end of what analysts surveyed by The Wall Street Journal projected, with forecasts between 1 million tons and 2 million tons.
Soybean sales for the week totaled 1.7 million tons for 2026/27, while wheat sales were 325,900 tons for 2026/27. Both totals were within analyst forecasts for the week.
CBOT grain futures are lower in pre-market trading. Most-active corn futures are down 0.6%, soybeans slide 0.2%, and wheat falls 1.3%.
To see related data, search "U.S. Export Sales: Weekly Sales Totals" in Dow Jones NewsPlus.
